models.name: Bonsai 2 27B
models.why: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B stores nearly every weight as -1/0/1, fits in 8.4GB and runs 26 tok/s on a 64GB M5 Pro Mac mini; the Oct 19 post that repeats the figure names no engine, so only the measured post backs the numbers.

engines.hardware: M5 Pro Mac mini, 64GB unified memory
engines.quant: Ternary weights (-1/0/1), fits in 8.4GB (about half Gemma 3 27B's footprint); 184 tok/s LFM2.5-24B-A2B and 106 tok/s Qwen3 30B from the same list are other models
